scope: REM-002 history rewrite/removal of the prohibited blob from the publishable interval; local preparation is preserved and external/destructive authority is unresolved.

criteria.description: REM-001 preservation evidence is current enough to keep the rewrite boundary recoverable before any destructive action.
criteria.limitations: The prohibited blob is intentionally still reachable until the authorized rewrite is verified.

criteria.description: The requested resolution is bounded to the path and publishable interval identified by the dry-run, with a recoverable source and an isolated execution route.
criteria.limitations: No post-rewrite object proof or remote result exists yet; those remain execution evidence.

criteria.description: The human authority decision is explicit, current, and bound to the exact REM-002 gate and scope; execution is routed through post-rewrite verification before any push.
criteria.limitations: This authorizes only the exact REM-002 rewrite/removal/push boundary; it does not authorize deployment, target operations, CI/release governance, unrelated refs or unrelated destructive actions.

gaps: The prohibited .gauntlet/state.json blob remains reachable in the current publishable interval until the rewrite runs.
Post-rewrite object inventory, recovery clone and remote lease result are not yet observed.
CI/release, target, UAT, independent critique and go/no-go remain outside this gate.

conditions.description: Before push, verify the rewritten candidate has no blob >=100 MiB in the exact refs intended for push and that all required commits remain recoverable from a fresh candidate bundle/clone.
conditions.impact: The local rewrite may proceed, but a failed verification prevents the push action and reopens the gate.
conditions.owner: Codex acting under the confirmed human authority
conditions.due_or_trigger: Immediately after the isolated rewrite and before push
conditions.verification_method: Object-size inventory, ref reachability, commit-count comparison, bundle verification and fresh recovery clone.

conditions.description: Immediately before push, verify the remote main lease still equals the recorded origin/main baseline and push only the exact candidate branch to origin/main with force-with-lease.
conditions.impact: A changed remote ref or rejected protected-branch policy stops publication without retrying an unsafe push.
conditions.owner: Codex acting under the confirmed human authority
conditions.verification_method: Exact ls-remote comparison followed by one force-with-lease push limited to refs/heads/main.

authority.scope: REM-002 history rewrite/removal of the prohibited blob from the publishable interval; local preparation is preserved and external/destructive authority is unresolved.
authority.decision: Confirmed authority to execute the REM-002 history rewrite/removal of the prohibited blob and the authorized push for this exact scope, after backup and recovery validation.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate immediately after any source/control mutation, remote ref change, or verification failure.

revalidation_triggers: The source/control worktree or backup/recovery evidence changes.
The public push interval, refs or prohibited blob inventory changes.
Any post-rewrite verification fails or the remote lease differs from the recorded baseline.
